offer.text: We were too slow at the mine and the trail went cold... but I won't stop. Light a candle at the shrine for me — three of them — so they can find their way back, wherever they are.

accept.text: Thank you for not giving up on us. Three candles, for hope.

decline.text: Even a flicker of light would mean so much right now.

in_progress.text: Have you the candles for the shrine?

ready.text: Three little flames against all that dark. It's something. It's hope.

complete.text: Maybe they'll see the light and follow it home. Maybe. You kept hope alive when I couldn't — and that's a gift in itself.
